ldap_uris.description: LDAP server URIs (e.g., ldap://, ldaps://, or ldapi://). At least one required.

ldap_base.description: Default search base DN for directory queries.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as when performing authenticated searches. Leave blank for anonymous bind.

ldap_bind_pw.description: Password for the bind DN above. Only needed if bind_dn is set.

sasl_mech.description: SASL mechanism (e.g., GSSAPI) for Kerberos auth. Leave empty to disable.

tls_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server TLS certificates.

tls_key.description: Client private key for mutual TLS (optional, must match cert).

ssl_mode.description: TLS mode: 'start_tls', 'ldaps', or empty string for plain LDAP.

reconnect_retry.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed LDAP connection.

nslcd_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle concurrent requests.

min_uid.description: Minimum UID to include in passwd/group lookups (e.g., exclude system accounts).

max_uid.description: Maximum UID to include in lookups.

default.name: passwd
default.map_passwd: uid uidNumber cn homeDirectory loginShell gidNumber gecos shadowLastChange
default.map_shadow: uid userPassword shadowLastChange shadowMax shadowWarning shadowInactive shadowExpire shadowFlag

user_maps.description: User maps configuration (passwd, shadow, group). See nslcd.conf man page for details.

k5start_start.description: Whether to force starting k5start: "yes" to enable, empty (or any other value) to disable. Default empty (disabled unless auto-detected).

k5start_keytab.description: Path to Kerberos keytab file for k5start.

k5start_ccrefresh.description: Seconds between Kerberos ticket refresh by k5start.

k5start_principal.description: Kerberos principal for k5start. Must match keytab.
